data.text: Plan: package the existing verified design into `outputs/` using JLCPCB Gerber/drill settings, DXF/STEP outline exports, schematic/PCB SVG renders, and a grouped ordering BOM (`refdes,MPN,qty`). Files affected: generated outputs plus changelog/decision documentation. Risks: every export must succeed; PCB DRC/ERC and documentation drift must remain clean; RF stackup and antenna geometry remain explicitly draft-only and are not altered.

args.why: Create the required fabrication, mechanical, visual-review, and ordering package from the existing KiCad design without changing its electrical or RF design.
args.what_changes:
- Export JLCPCB-profile Gerbers and drill files into `outputs/`.
- Export the board outline as DXF and the assembled board as STEP into `outputs/`.
- Export schematic and PCB SVG renders.
- Generate `outputs/BOM.csv` from `docs/BOM.md` with columns `refdes,MPN,qty`, grouping identical MPNs where appropriate.
- Record the outputs-stage rationale, generated files, and verification in the design documentation.
args.tasks:
- [ ] Inspect the board setup and any existing output configuration.
- [ ] Generate JLCPCB Gerbers and drill files; confirm every command succeeds.
- [ ] Generate DXF and STEP mechanical exports; confirm every command succeeds.
- [ ] Export schematic and PCB SVG renders; confirm both succeed.
- [ ] Generate and validate the ordering BOM CSV against `docs/BOM.md`.
- [ ] Run ERC and DRC and reconcile all violations.
- [ ] Run schematic legibility and documentation drift checks.
- [ ] Update decisions and changelog, then finish only after all gates pass.
